name: HelioField
description: 3D coronal magnetic field (PFSS, optional Schatten current sheet), heliospheric current sheet and spacecraft magnetic connectivity for any date since 2010-05-01. Every view is a URL; images can also be made without a browser with the Python scripts.

viewer.notes: Omit parameters to use the defaults. A date without a daily product is computed in the browser (WebGL, a few seconds); the full page asks the user to confirm first, embed=1 does not.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Date of the field. Recent days are daily server products; other days are computed in the browser from the SDO/HMI rotation map covering the date.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Camera: from Earth, over the north pole, or zoomed out to the whole fleet. Default: an oblique view.

parameters.name: cam
parameters.description: Fixed camera: Carrington longitude and latitude [deg] and distance [display units]. Overrides view.

parameters.name: layers
parameters.description: photo: surface B_r; foot: open-field footprints (coronal holes); closed/open: field lines; ext: open lines continued into the heliosphere; ss: source-surface B_r; pil: neutral line; hcs: heliospheric current sheet; fleet: planets and spacecraft; spiral: their magnetic connections; cloud: footpoint spread.

parameters.name: v
parameters.description: Solar-wind speed for the spirals and connections.

parameters.name: conn
parameters.description: sc: each spacecraft connects at the WSA-type speed of its own footpoint.

parameters.name: ext
parameters.description: radial: extended open lines go straight out instead of as Parker spirals.

parameters.name: rmax
parameters.description: Extent of the current sheet and extended lines.

parameters.name: scale
parameters.description: true: true distances (default: log-compressed beyond the source surface).

parameters.name: lines
parameters.description: Number of field lines drawn.

parameters.name: ss
parameters.description: Source-surface opacity.

parameters.name: rss
parameters.description: Source-surface height (dates computed in the browser).

parameters.name: scs
parameters.description: Couple the Schatten current-sheet model out to this radius (dates computed in the browser).

parameters.name: rotate
parameters.description: Rotate slowly.

parameters.name: theme
parameters.description: Colour theme (default: the system's).

parameters.name: embed
parameters.description: Embedded layout for iframes.

parameters.name: controls
parameters.description: With embed=1: hide the date bar.

parameters.name: panel
parameters.description: Start with the menu closed or open.

parameters.name: series
parameters.description: Hide or show the solar-cycle panel.

scripts.description: Python scripts (NumPy, SciPy, Matplotlib) that fetch the page's inputs for a date, solve the same model as the browser, and write the figures (PNG, PDF) and the results (NetCDF + JSON header). No browser needed.

connectivity.description: For one date: each in-situ spacecraft's magnetic connection (ballistic Parker spiral and PFSS or PFSS + SCS field line), travel and source times, predicted IMF polarity with spread agreement and angle to the current sheet, the polarity over a rotation, HelioFleet observations (IRIS, Hinode/EIS, DKIST, Solar Orbiter) of the source region during the source-time window, and the current sheet in coronagraph fields of view.

parameters.name: scs
parameters.description: Couple the Schatten current-sheet model out to this radius [R_sun]; omit for PFSS.

parameters.name: conn
parameters.description: Self-consistent speeds (each spacecraft at its footpoint's WSA-type speed).

parameters.name: focus
parameters.description: Spacecraft whose source-region observations are listed and drawn.

parameters.name: bg
parameters.description: Source map shows open-field regions instead of the photospheric field.

parameters.name: ins
parameters.description: Coronagraph or imager whose field is shown.
